bullets: Owned coordination and architecture across a 9-workstream platform build: authored 3 architecture decision records (ADRs), maintained the phase proposal / project plan, ran cross-workstream code reviews, and prepared next-phase planning — coordinating execution across a 3-person team (founder + 2 engineers).

Built the multi-tenant security layer for a tax-compliance platform: per-request tenant context, per-tenant key derivation, tamper-evident audit logging; drove an OWASP cross-tenant isolation audit backed by 105 isolation tests.

Owned infrastructure-as-code — 11 Terraform modules managing 30+ AWS resources (VPC, KMS, EFS, IAM, CloudWatch, Secrets Manager, RDS, CloudTrail), each verified against live AWS rather than state alone.

Ran the extraction accuracy baseline and found the model was only ~10% accurate — and that its confidence was inversely correlated with correctness (most confident when most wrong). That finding directly shaped the accuracy-gate design for the validation framework I owned.

Shipped case-management and alerting API features and authored a step-by-step deployment runbook with rollback boundaries and acceptance checks; on the final day cleared the review queue — 22 PRs merged with seven verified Terraform applies in a 5,570-test codebase.
Developed a verification practice (confirming CI gates and audit controls actually execute) that repeatedly surfaced silent failures others missed.
Built Excel automation reducing work by 40%
Root cause analysis on data discrepancies
